verdict.rationale: Claude Code exposes a CLI and Agent SDK that give programmatic, scriptable access to most core capabilities (search, edit, git, CI, piping) with 'full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions', suggesting strong API/CLI parity for coding tasks. However, several UI-specific surfaces—visual diff review, remote control from phone/browser, teleport between web/mobile and terminal, scheduling UI—are described as distinct product features without explicit confirmation that every such capability is also reachable via the SDK/API.
